notes.title: Regular Update / Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
Player now heals anywhere, but heals 50% faster while at your Camp
Solved issues related to building inside Caves / Dungeons
Archers no longer attack Totem (this was a bug)
Fixed Combat Icon scaling glitch
Fixed Spider layering issue
Several UI Enhancements

notes.title: UI Enhancement Update
notes.notes:
Several new UI ToolTips have been added explaining certain functionality (such as the Build Level experience system), and tool buttons now have a tint to indicate which are most needed. Animated ring effects have also been added to gameplay areas of interest / importance.

Hopefully these improvements will help new players get started!

notes.title: Post-Release Update v1.5.1
notes.notes:
· Added Identity Key to Graph Displays.
· Added additional detail to build animations.
· Fixed floating Teleport Tiles blocking your path.
· Duplicated UI Help Level control on the GameBar for easy reference.
· Fixed issue with Projectiles not aligning with direction of movement.

notes.title: Improvements and Enhancements
notes.notes:
[b]Things are looking good for launch day! The major [i](known)[/i] issues have been resolved:[/b]
- Mages and Archers now populate all Walls / Towers, from most to least distant from House.
- Fixed a bug with back-walls spawning wrong wall type.
- Nests no longer spawn between walls on game load.
- Fixed Unit Stationed flags on game load.

There are still a few things to finish up, but unless any further issues come up during testing we are go for launch (day)!
